title: Bound Legacy backfill probes and isolate Paper mark persistence
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Correct the two performance defects verified by the immediately preceding Production check: recurring Legacy historical-backfill membership-query timeouts and synchronous Paper position-mark persistence that stalls the ordinary market-data side-effect queue.
inScope: Replace only the Legacy PaperRun old-payload membership lookup inside GetHistoricalPaperFakFeeBackfillCandidatesAsync with bounded candidate-driven probes of the already deployed expression index, while preserving the exact candidate set and the existing one-snapshot read-only transaction.
Stop the Production market-data side-effect path from awaiting Paper position-mark database persistence; retain all order, fill, expiry and settlement processing on its current path.

Keep Paper position marks refreshed by the already registered PaperPositionMarkWorker at its existing configured interval and with its existing compare-and-set persistence behavior; do not add a second queue or worker.

Add focused source and PostgreSQL integration tests for exact Legacy membership parity and focused service tests proving that market-data processing does not call synchronous batch mark persistence while the dedicated mark worker remains registered.

Update only the directly affected documentation and mandatory requirement/context/history records, then run focused tests, a Release solution build, requirement validation and independent semantic review.
outOfScope: No Production database write, schema/index/migration change, service restart, deployment, configuration change, strategy/order mutation or server repair.

No change to strategy decisions, risk rules, Paper or Live order semantics, order sizing, fills, expiries, settlements, balances, PnL, ROI, fees, historical candidate membership, chronological paging or accounting results.
No change to the existing PaperPositionMarkWorker interval, its REST/cache price acquisition, its single-position compare-and-set method, or its error policy.

No attempt to diagnose or repair the newly observed abrupt Production process stop: the accessible service log ended without a shutdown or fatal record, so its cause remains unknown and is not silently attributed to either performance defect.
No unrelated cleanup, refactoring, queue-topology change, retry framework, generalized batching system or broad performance audit.
scope.periodOrFilter: Future executions after user-controlled build and deployment. Legacy scope is one caller-selected strategy, immutable cutoff and optional full tuple cursor. Paper-mark scope is the ordinary DI-wired market-data side-effect path; Maker-GTD evidence, order/fill/expiry/settlement work and historical rows are unchanged.
scope.firstVerification: Read-only Production evidence was captured from 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader and server logs: the Legacy old-payload lookup repeatedly exceeded its 10-second command timeout; market-data queue delay reached 9766.7168 ms with TryUpdatePaperPositionMarks/ExecuteCommand taking 8259.4651 ms and pending work reaching 337. The deployed Legacy expression index is valid/ready, and local source inspection confirmed both exact call paths before editing.

requirements.text: Make the Legacy PaperRun old-payload membership phase bounded by the current candidate batch and the existing expression index without changing which candidates are excluded.
acceptanceCriteria: The Legacy lookup is driven from the distinct current candidate paper-order IDs, limited to the existing maximum page-size batch, and performs an indexable existence probe for each candidate instead of a DISTINCT scan driven from historical_gross_net_parity_audit.
The exact predicates remain source_kind='PaperRun', the current calculation version, operation_kind='AccountingDecision', and old_payload_json paper_order_id equality.

The existing 10-second command timeout, REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction, immutable cutoff, cursor, strategy/source/status filters, other parity exclusions, chronological ordering, N+1 page limit and returned payload are unchanged.

Focused real-PostgreSQL tests prove identical inclusion/exclusion for every existing parity binding shape, including the orphan-compatible legacy PaperRun old-payload binding, and source-contract tests prove the candidate-driven indexed query shape.

verification.expected: All focused source-contract and real-PostgreSQL integration tests pass, including exact legacy old-payload membership and paging parity.

verification.command: Run EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) in BEGIN READ ONLY with SET LOCAL statement_timeout='15s' against 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader for an exact bounded candidate batch, without changing Production.
verification.expected: The proposed lookup completes within 15 seconds, is driven by the bounded candidate input and uses the deployed historical parity expression index for the equality probe; returned membership matches the current semantics for the same batch.

requirements.text: Remove synchronous Paper position-mark database persistence from the ordinary Production market-data side-effect critical path while preserving its existing dedicated refresh path and all trading lifecycle work.
acceptanceCriteria: The DI-wired MarketDataSideEffectHandler invokes PaperTradingMarketDataUpdater with position-mark persistence disabled, so TryUpdatePaperPositionMarksAsync cannot delay completion of an ordinary queued market-data event.

The existing PaperPositionMarkWorker remains registered and continues to refresh marks at the existing configured interval through IPaperPositionMarkProcessor and the current single-position compare-and-set persistence path.

Market-resolved settlement, Maker-GTD and ordinary Paper order evidence, fill simulation, fill/order persistence, expiry, position fill application and exposure-cache updates remain on their current paths and are not made fire-and-forget.

A focused test with mark persistence made deliberately non-completing proves that the ordinary DI-wired market-data handler completes without calling it, while focused lifecycle tests continue to pass.
No configuration, database schema/index, new background worker, new queue or retry mechanism is introduced.

verification.expected: All focused market-data, Paper lifecycle, non-blocking handler and dedicated mark-worker isolation tests pass.

requirements.text: Deliver only the approved local source correction with deterministic verification and no Production mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: PolyCopyTrader.sln builds in Release with zero errors after the focused tests pass.
git diff --check, WorkingTree and Staged requirement validation pass, and every governed changed path maps to REQ-001, REQ-002 or this delivery requirement.
An independent reviewer compares both verbatim user requests, the approved contract, the complete diff and verification evidence and returns PASS with no open findings.
All disposable build, test and diagnostic artifacts are created only inside the marked D:\CodexTemp run and that exact run is removed before completion.
The approval checkpoint is committed before product edits; final task commits are pushed to the configured upstream without incorporating unrelated pre-existing context/history changes.

verification.expected: Release solution build succeeds with zero errors.

verification.command: Run git diff --check, scripts/requirements/Validate-RequirementContract.ps1 in WorkingTree and Staged modes, inspect the task-only diff, verify protected D:\CodexTemp cleanup, and obtain independent semantic review.
verification.expected: All checks pass, the exact marked temporary run is absent, and reviewer verdict is PASS with no open findings.
